name: Money Manager (Remove Ads)
description:
“Money Manager” is an optimized application for personal account management. 

Household account management is complicated. But we make it simple by simplifying the things that are complex. The default settings will get you started, and once you get used to it, you can alter the settings according to your needs with the highly flexible and customizable functions available. 

- Super easy and simple to enter data anytime, anywhere. 
- View your spending tendencies graphically. 
- View statistics by simply entering the data. 
- Search and calculator functions. 
- Set up sub-categories and main categories as necessary. 
- Manage all your accounts at once. 
- Use multiple currencies. 
- Check weekly, monthly, and annual statistics. 
- Use the calendar view. 
- Use budget planning features to plan weekly, monthly, and annual budgets. 
- Change the start date of the month. 

※ Applying double entry bookkeeping 
It facilitates efficient account management. Automatically double entry bookkeeping. 

※ PC manager function 
You can view ‘“Money Manager” application using Wi-Fi or 3G. You can edit and sort the data by date, category or account group on the screen of your PC. In addition, you can see fluctuations of your accounts indicated on graphs on your PC. 

※ Budget management function 
You can manage your budget. It shows your budget and expenditures on a graph so you can compare the amount of your expenditures against your budget quickly. 

※ Credit Card / Debit Card management function 
When entering a future payment date, you can see the payment amount and outstanding balance on the accounts page. You can connect your debit card to your accounts so that expenses are automatically recorded under a specific account. 

※ Passcode 
You can specify the desired time lapse before the app requests a passcode. 

※ Automatic money transfer and frequency functions 
You can set up automatic money transfers between your accounts and configure the frequency of those transfers. 

※ Sort expenses by the recipient 
You can sort your expenses by the recipient and view this information graphically. 

※ Payment Profiles 
You can easily enter frequent expenditures by creating payment profiles. 

※ Backup / Restore 
You can backup and restore your data via email, iTunes and iCloud. 

※ Multiple currency support – you can have individual entries in multiple currencies, and configure each account to calculate the total balance in your desired currency.

Subscription pricing and terms:

Money Manager offers auto-renewing monthly subscription at US$2.49/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at US$19.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the Money Manager Data Sync Service while you maintain an active subscription.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.

name: AutoSleep: Watch Sleep Tracker
description:
Automatically track your sleep from your Apple Watch*. No buttons to press. Even the Watch app is optional! Just sleep!

Total Privacy.
-------------
AutoSleep has no user analytics tracking. No advertising plugins. No 3rd party code. No data upload.
Ask your "free" sleep app if they can say the same.

Everything Included.
--------------------
No extra In App Purchases. No subscriptions. 

Apple Sleep Stages
-----------------
Full integration with Sleep Stages from the Apple Sleep app, so you have the option to use the Apple Sleep app and view all the information in AutoSleep.

Functions
-----------------
AutoSleep includes all the information and functionality you need for sleep monitoring, including:
Time Asleep – sleep duration and sleep bank balance
Sleep Rating – a consolidated rating score of your sleep
Sleep Rings – fill your sleep rings with quality sleep, including heart rate, deep sleep and REM
Apple Sleep Stages – option to use the data from the Apple Sleep app
Sleep Apnea - discover if you have sleep apnea
Sleep Blood Oxygen – measurements while sleeping
Respiration Rate – track your breathes per minute
Noise – environmental noise measurements
Sleep Analysis – view detailed graphs and breakups on your sleep cycles
Sleep Fuel – measure the quality and efficiency of your sleep
Snoring Intensity - using the AutoSnore app, view how snoring impacts your sleep quality
Tonight’s Bedtime – recommends your latest bedtime based on your habits
Readiness – indicates your physical and mental stress
Temperature – track your sleeping wrist temperature
Sleep Consistency – learn about your time to bed behaviours
Lights Off – track the time to fall asleep
Live Sleep Tracking – view your sleep statistics during the night
Smart Alarm – Watch in-built smart alarm to help you wake in lighter sleep 
Widgets – fantastic range of iPhone widgets
Complications – multiple Watch face options 
HomeKit – full integration with Apple HomeKit 
Emojis & Notes – record comments and tags to your sleep session
Explore – deep dive analytics views
Siri – use with Siri voice commands
Shortcuts – create your own shortcuts that you use with AutoSleep
Adjust – a simple function to adjust sleep/wake detection individual to you
History – advanced graphs and trends
Configuration – change the theme and design your clock sleep rings
Setup – customise your sleep goals, setup notifications and reminders
Exports – exporting options to save your data

About AutoSleep
-----------------
Using Advanced Heuristics AutoSleep works out how long you've slept so you don't have to.

If you DO wear your Watch to bed, you don't need to do a single thing. AutoSleep will track your sleep & quality and send you a notification in the morning.

Even if you don't wear your Watch to bed, AutoSleep can track your time in bed. It's extremely simple. If you DON'T wear your Watch to bed, then simply take your Watch off before you go to sleep. As soon as you touch your iPhone or put your Watch back on in the morning then AutoSleep will know that you have finished sleeping. 

As everyone is a little bit different. AutoSleep provides a simple setup wizard and an option to tweak if you are a very restless sleeper. 

AutoSleep also integrates beautifully with the Eclipse Yourself and HeartWatch apps, our premier heart, health, activity, recovery and readiness monitoring apps.

name: AGAIN. Rehearsal Notes
description:
AGAIN. is the rehearsal app that remembers why the band stopped.

You run the tune. Somebody stops it. "Bass, you're early on the bridge — verse two is four bars, not eight." Everyone nods. Next week nobody remembers. AGAIN. does.

PUT THE PHONE WHERE IT CAN HEAR THE ROOM
Tap Record and play. Tell the band you're recording. AGAIN. keeps going with the screen off, as long as the rehearsal runs. Or import a recording you already made.

IT FINDS EVERY STOP
On-device sound analysis tells music from talking. Each time the band stops to talk, that stop becomes a rehearsal letter — A, B, C — like the boxed letters in a score.

IT WRITES THE NOTES
What was said after each stop is transcribed on your iPhone and turned into short notes: who it's for, which song, what kind of fix (tempo, entrance, ending, arrangement, dynamics, sound, pitch, lyrics). Wrong? Edit any note, or write your own.

▶ THE 15 SECONDS BEFORE
Every stop and every note has a play button that plays the music right before the band stopped. No scrubbing. Everyone hears the spot.

BY SONG, BY PLAYER, BY WORD
Songs: every note on each tune, across rehearsals. Players: each musician's list, ready to send. Search: notes and full transcripts.

YOURS, ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No ads. No servers. Recordings, transcripts and notes stay on your iPhone. Speech recognition and note-writing run on device.

AGAIN. records other people's voices. Always tell the room you're recording and follow the recording laws where you play.

name: CalCs - Calendar Complications
description:
CalCs (short for "Calendar Complications") is a watchOS-only app that provides various complications related to the calendar.

--Important Notes--
The features built into the main body of this app are limited to listing events/reminders & displaying a monthly calendar.
All other features are provided through complications & the Smart Stack.

●If you download CalCs from the iPhone App Store, due to synchronization issues between the iPhone & Apple Watch, CalCs may not appear on the Apple Watch.
According to Apple's specifications, watchOS-only apps cannot be re-downloaded from the App Store app on the iPhone.
Therefore, please use the App Store app "on your Apple Watch" & follow the steps below to re-download it.
・Scroll to the bottom→"Account"→"Purchased"→"CalCs"→re-download
-------------------

Key Features
●Supports a variety of complications such as date display, events/reminders display, & monthly calendar display

・Date Display
Displays the current date in various formats.

・Event/Reminder Display
Displays events/reminders synced with your iPhone.
You can choose whether or not to include all-day events.

・Monthly Calendar Display
Displays the monthly calendar in various formats.
You can choose to start the week on Monday.
Supports holidays in some areas.
*Holiday data depends on external APIs & may be incomplete.
Only Modular Duo supporting models (Series 7+, not SE series) can show a month calendar using 2 large rectangles. Other models can show it in 1, with smaller font.

●In the main app, events/reminders, & the monthly calendar are displayed
Tapping the complication opens the app, where you can view the list of events/reminders synced with your iPhone, as well as the monthly calendar.

*Only incomplete reminders are displayed.
*The app currently does not have functionality to add, edit, or delete events/reminders, nor to mark reminders as complete.

●Minimal Setting Options
To avoid complicating settings on the small Apple Watch screen, the settings only allow you to select which calendar/reminder lists to display.

*Notes
・The corner complications, circular complications, & large rectangular complications are supported only on Apple Watch Series 4 & later, so CalCs is not guaranteed to work on Series 3 or earlier models.

・Due to the limitations of watchOS complication display updates, complications may not immediately reflect changes when the date changes or after events or reminders are added or edited on the iPhone.

・After placing a complication for the 1st time, it may take some time for it to actually appear.

・If the complication is not updating, try tapping the complication to open CalCs, as this may refresh the data.

・If the complication is not updated even after launching CalCs, the issue may be resolved by 1 of the following methods. Please try them.
1.Restart both your iPhone & Apple Watch.

2.Force restart CalCs
①With CalCs open, press & hold the side button.
②When the screen for emergency call & power off appears, press & hold the Digital Crown.

3.Reinstall CalCs
①Press the Digital Crown to display the app list.
②Press & hold CalCs, then tap the × button to delete it when it appears.
③Launch the App Store app on your Apple Watch.
④Scroll to the bottom→"Account"→"Purchased"→"CalCs"→Re-download.

・If the complication does not update after force quitting & restarting CalCs, try restarting both your iPhone & Apple Watch, as it may resolve the issue.

・If event information is not displayed on the app's main event/reminder list screen or in complications, it may be because full access to the calendar has not been granted.
The issue may be resolved by following the steps below to re-enable full access permission to the calendar. Please give it a try.
①Open the "Privacy & Security" section in the iPhone Settings app & tap "Calendars".
②Change CalCs' calendar access to "None", then select "Add Events Only".
③When you open CalCs, you will be prompted to grant full access, so tap "Allow Full Access".

Trash talk, bluff, and betray your friends in real-time. Our high-performance voice chat, powered by the getstream.io SDK, brings the psychological warfare to life as you manipulate your way to the top of the leaderboard.

NEW: SOLO AI MODE
No friends online? No problem. Challenge our dynamic AI bots in the all-new Solo Mode. These aren't predictable scripts—each AI player aims for its own victory using unpredictable, non-sequential strategies to keep you guessing. It is the perfect tactical brain teaser to sharpen your psychological skills before your next live match. Play anytime, anywhere, even when you are flying solo.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Host or Join: Create a live room in seconds or jump into a solo session against the AI.
2. The Choice: Everyone picks a number between 1 and 100 simultaneously.
3. The Trap: The highest number is too obvious. The lowest is too safe. Only the SECOND highest takes the point.
4. The Grind: Score, adapt, and climb the leaderboard. Rounds flow instantly until the session ends.

NOTE: Brink features private lobbies for friends. Share your room code to invite your squad, or jump into Solo AI mode for an instant challenge.

WHY IT IS ADDICTIVE
Brink blends social deduction, number theory, and tactical risk-taking. If you always go big, you lose. If you always play it safe, you lose. You must calibrate your strategy based on lobby tempo, momentum swings, and the unique personality of your opponents—human or AI.

• Mind Games: Perfect for quick sessions, party hangouts, or competitive strategy grinds.
• Real-Time Thrills: Watch friends (or bots) join the lobby and feel the pulse of anticipation.
• Tactical Depth: Calibrate your risk based on emergent player behavior and shifting table meta.

Master the brink. Win by almost winning.

name: Super Farming Boy
description:
** Appstore Awards - Apple TV App of the Year 2025 - Finalist **
** PocketGamer Awards 2025 - Best Indie Game - Finalist **
** Gamescom Latam 2025 - Best Latam Game - Finalist **

Super Farming Boy™ is an exciting mix of ACTION, PUZZLE, and FARMING SIM, heavily relying on CHAIN REACTIONS and COMBOS.      

Story
In Super Farming Boy™, you play as Super, whose mom and friends have been captured by your evil nemesis, KORPO®©TM, who unlawfully hires you to work on your own land, taxing all proceeds for himself! Now, with your friends and mom up for sale, you must harvest your way through challenging adventures, saving enough to buy your mom and friends back!

Gameplay Mechanics
In Super Farming Boy™, there are no tools because you are the tool. With the simple push of a button, you can transform into a shovel, a hammer, a pickaxe, a watering can, and more! Super Farming Boy™ can even FLY! The game's central mechanic revolves around chain reactions and combos. The magical seed creatures in this world, once harvested, trigger specific chain-reaction effects that enable you to optimize your farm in ways never seen before in a farming game. These chain reaction and combo powers also serve as your means of defense against creatures, help optimize your daily stamina usage, and facilitate various actions such as chopping down trees, demolishing boulders, removing weeds, collecting items, defeating bosses, and much more! Explore whimsical weathers and extraordinarily unusual seasons, such as Radioactive Season, Timewarp Season, and Volcanic Season. There's even a season set underwater! Super Farming Boy™ has been meticulously designed with touch controls in mind. The gameplay is incredibly intuitive: everything is drag-and-droppable and supports both classic joystick controllers (XBOX, Bluetooth, PS, Joycon, Switch Pro Controllers), keyboard, and touch simultaneously!

Features

Superhero abilities
Super Farming Boy™ has the ability to walk, run, and even fly! Additionally, he can transform into any tool with a simple push or tap of a button—be it a shovel, pickaxe, axe, or hammer, and more!

Chain reaction and combos
Optimize your farm by harvesting a single crop and witnessing the chain and combo effects efficiently harvest your entire farm at once. However, meticulous and strategic planning in your planting efforts is essential!

Unlock & upgrade supertools
All SuperTools and powers in Super Farming Boy™ come in the form of old-school superhero trading cards. Unlock, collect and upgrade them all!

Unusual seasons to discover
Explore a plethora of seasons in Super Farming Boy™, including Spring, Winteria, Volcanic, Radioactive, Underwater (coming soon), and Timewarp (coming soon).

Idle helpers to collect
Rescue all your friend-pets by purchasing them back from Korpo™®©! Each pet comes with a unique idle mechanic to help automate your farm, like auto-watering, auto-hammering, and more.

No inventory management
Super Farming Boy™ eliminates the need for inventory management. All seeds and idle helpers are creatures that follow you around wherever you go, avoiding the hassle of an ever-filling inventory!

Beauty up and customize it all
Personalize your BlobHouse with fantastic beauty items such as bedside tables, rugs, and beds! Your home will be uniquely yours and look amazing with your creative touch.

Boss fights... in a farming game?
Utilize your crops' combo and chain reaction powers to defend your farm against evil creatures like pests and seasonal bosses!

Touch controls that are actually good
Enjoy very intuitive touch controls—drag and drop every item in the game! Including NPCs, seeds, idle helpers, and Super Farming Boy™ himself!. Alternatively, play with your favorite XBOX/PS or Bluetooth controller.

description:
Border Officer – A Document, Control, and Security Game

Every day is a new day at the border.
Every day, new faces arrive.
Behind every face lies a story, a dream… or a threat.

Border Officer puts you at the center of the toughest decisions as a border officer in a document control and security game.
You must act according to rules, documents, and presidential orders; the cost of a small mistake can be paid by the entire country.

Your Mission
	•	Inspect the documents of incoming characters
	•	Examine stamps and detect forged documents
	•	Scan bags using X-ray screening and find illegal items
	•	Identify and capture wanted criminals
	•	Earn money by making the right decisions

Scanning, Searching, and Security

Not every bag is innocent.
Not every document is valid.

Protect the border using scanning and search systems. Maintain security—but do not reject the innocent.

Some choices satisfy the public; others push the country toward chaos.

The border is yours. The decision is yours. The consequences are ours.

name: The Greedy Cave
description:
In a land far, far away there once was a vast continent called Milton. It was a land where the power of rule came by the sword and the arcane, where Men who devoted themselves to the blade or to magecraft, could become the finest warriors, wisest wizards or the greatest adventurers. In this land, there are several kingdoms divided by borders but united through history. Countless stories of alliances, upheaval, and moments of peace bedeck this tapestry, but that is a tale for another day. 

Our story begins in a remote kingdom to the north, Iblis, an obscure and oft-forgotten place. It is a wild and barren land, a place where its people scrape a living from the earth, mining minerals for the lords of the south. On occasion, adventurers would stop by for the night but never linger. Until one day, a fledgling adventurer lost his way and stumbled into a hole. The story might have ended then had he not come back, but return he did, with sacks of gold and glittering treasure. 

Like a fierce gale from the north, news of his fame and fortune fanned across the kingdoms overnight, and kings sent their bravest warriors and adventurers to clear the cavern of monsters in search of treasure. Even peasants wanting a part of this newfound wealth partook in these expeditions. In no time at all, a bustling town had sprung up in this forgotten place. People set up camps, and formed their own groups to explore the cave. Clever merchants not missing this opportunity, built taverns and shops near the cave, selling equipment and potions to eager adventurers. At first, everything seemed fine. As explorers delved into the caves, they encountered new creatures and discovered new treasures. Mysteries continued to pour forth from the cave, yet nobody knew where the source of the secrets lay. However, as the explorations continued, the balance of wealth beyond the cave began to waver, and cracks appeared among those adventurers who had previously worked arm-in-arm. The latecomers or weak, limited to wandering the upper levels of the cave, could only watch as the veteran adventurers brought treasure after treasure from the deep. They began harboring dark thoughts as they watched the veteran adventurers grow arrogant from their largesse, ordering people around, hoarding secrets from the rest. The place became a festering pool of suspicions and greed, mired in a jealous rage. 

It started with an adventurer disappearing in the cave. Rumors circulated he had found some legendary treasure and hoarded it for himself. Others said he had been guided to another world by some mysterious magic force in the cave. Still, the unspoken belief was that he had been murdered by a rival party and was buried somewhere beneath the caverns. Nobody knows exactly what happened, but people have continued to disappear ever since. As more people have gone missing, some adventurers have called it quits, others cling to hope, and a few continue to wait and see. Which brings us to you, an ordinary young man, coming into this extraordinary circumstance with purposes unknown to others. May you find what you seek in ...

--------------------------------------------------------
In " The Greedy Cave", you are a brave adventurer tasked with exploring a mysterious cave and battling all kinds of monsters.

Use your wits to defeat them, learn different skills, gain mighty equipment, challenge evil monster bosses, and decipher the mystery surrounding this cave...

Game Features

description:

The condition of the box and the disc also matters, so checking every item carefully is an important part of the job. Before you make a deal, you need to look at the details, consider the customer’s offer, and decide whether it is worth making a counteroffer. A single good negotiation can make a big difference.

As you earn more money, your shop begins to grow. You can improve your business, handle better trades, and build a stronger collection over time. The game combines second-hand game trading with simple negotiation mechanics, detailed item conditions, and a cozy retro pixel art style to create a satisfying shop management experience.

Grow your store, make better deals, collect great games, and become a true game dealer.

name: Farming Simulator 26 Mobile
description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
description:
The Kingdom has fallen. Time has turned back. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past. Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis
The legendary tower defense saga by Ironhide Game Studio returns. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, recruit the heroes who built the kingdom, and stop a young Vez'nan before darkness takes hold.

A PREQUEL, REWRITTEN
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Walk through known battlefields and uncover the moment everything went wrong.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them. Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS. 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.

name: MONOPOLY
description:
Play MONOPOLY on the go without distractions – no ads, no fuss! 

Challenge friends, family and fans from around the globe in the digital version of the official MONOPOLY board game, licensed by Hasbro. 

Head online to play your favourite board game with anyone, anywhere, at any time, or compete against state-of-the-art AI opponents offline. Plus, with the seamless PASS & PLAY mode, you can play the classic MONOPOLY board game with your friends with just one device! 

The classic MONOPOLY board game takes a bold leap into a new format, arriving on mobile with amazing graphics, smooth animations and a catchy soundtrack! 


HOW TO PLAY MONOPOLY

1. Download the official MONOPOLY app
2. Press “PLAY”
3. Pick a mode, board, dice and token
4. Roll the dice and move around the board
5. If you land on a property tile, you can buy it
6. Collect rent when other players land on it
7. Continue around the board, drawing cards when instructed – will you be hit with a surprise tax? Sent to jail? Or get a little bonus money? 
8. If you run out of money, you’ll be bankrupt and out of the game
9. The last player left with a profit wins! 

FEATURES

- MONOPOLY ON THE GO – No connection? No problem. Our roster of AI opponents are ready to challenge you! Or play with your friends offline with Pass & Play! 
- MULTIPLE MODES – Take on AI opponents in Single Player or compete against friends and family in Pass & Play or Online With Friends. Try out Online Multiplayer and face off against fellow tycoons from around the world! 
- EXCLUSIVE BOARDS – Experience the iconic board game like never before with exclusive boards and more! 
- AWESOME NEW TOKENS AND DICE – Whatever your style, MONOPOLY has a set of dice fit for a future tycoon! Pick from nostalgic classic tokens or brand-new designs exclusive to the mobile game.

Get the most authentic MONOPOLY experience with the official MONOPOLY mobile game!

The MONOPOLY name and logo, the distinctive design of the gameboard, the four corner squares, the MR. MONOPOLY name and character, as well as each of the distinctive elements of the board and playing pieces are trademarks of Hasbro for its property trading game and game equipment. © 1935, 2025 Hasbro. All Rights Reserved.

name: Black Border 2
description:
Inspect papers, prevent smuggling—keep the border safe or profit from corruption.

Ready to become a Border Police Officer? Step into the world of Black Border 2: Border Patrol Simulator and experience the intense pressure of national security. As a Customs Officer, your duty is to protect the nation from illegal smuggling. Inspect passports, scrutinize documents, and use advanced tools to make life-or-death decisions in this gripping police simulator game.

Take on the duty of a Border Patrol Agent and protect your nation's borders. Your role is crucial:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports, permits, and papers to approve or reject entrants.

Advanced Tools: Utilize X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and weigh stations to check vehicle legitimacy.

Canine Unit: Deploy your loyal service dog to sniff out concealed contraband and uncover secrets.

Strategic Decisions: Every choice you make impacts the safety of your country.

NEW FEATURES in Black Border 2:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports and permits to approve or reject entrants as a customs officer.

Endless Mode: Test your border patrol skills in a nonstop, challenging experience.

Bus Arrivals: Manage large buses and check every passenger's documents carefully.

Advanced Scanning: Utilize new X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and contraband.

Weigh Stations: Ensure vehicle weights match their records, a key part of your police duty.

Canine Unit: Your faithful service dog is now a crucial partner in finding hidden contraband.

Each day as a border inspector brings new challenges that will push your customs police skills to the limit. Are you ready to face the pressure and become a true hero of national security?

Download Black Border 2 today and get ready to defend the nation!

name: Monoposto
description:
Monoposto is an amazing independent racing game with single seater open-wheel cars. Compete in the new 2026 season: there are 34 racing tracks waiting for you.

-Full unlocked game
-No Ads
-34 realistic tracks
-Online Multiplayer Duel
-Quick race, Single Race and Championship mode
-Qualifying session
-Dynamic weather
-Race session with up to 24 cars
-Pit stop during qualify and race
-Car repair and setup during pit stop
-Car setup before the race
-Customization of Cars and Drivers names
-Create your livery
-Choose your Driver
-8 different camera view
-Spectator TV mode race view
-Many options to customize your driving experience
-External and MFi game controller support

name: Balatro
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro mobile game!

Hypnotic and endlessly satisfying, Balatro is a magical mix of card games like Solitaire and Poker, that lets you twist the rules in ways never seen before!

Your goal is to beat the Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands.

Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Win enough chips to beat tricky bosses, and find hidden bonus hands and decks as you play. You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices.
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Need for Speed™ Most Wanted
description:
APP STORE BEST OF 2012! Thanks to all our fans for making Most Wanted one of the year’s biggest hits.

"The street racer that iOS devices have been waiting for" (PocketGamer, 9/10 Gold Award)

“It pushes the mobile platform to its utmost limits and doesn’t even break a sweat” (Capsule Computers)

Buckle up, hit the gas and hold on tight; you’re in for the ride of your life. Outrun cops, outsmart rivals – and outdrive your friends – in the most dangerous Need for Speed yet. Do you dare to be the Most Wanted?

Note: Due to its revved-up graphics and gameplay, you’ll need 1.8GB of free space on your device in order to install this game.

MAKE TROUBLE, GET WANTED
Evade a relentless police force while you clash with street racers. Race and chase hot cars like the SRT Viper GTS, Porsche 911 Carrera S, Hummer H1 Alpha, and many more. Feel the intensity of no-brakes-allowed street racing with realistic full-car damage for the first time on mobile. 

LEAVE YOUR MARK
Log into Origin to check the Wanted List and find out who is the Most Wanted across platforms and among your friends. Then, challenge your friends and prove your racing skills in nonstop competition. 

GO FROM ZERO TO MOST WANTED…
• Choose and customize over 40 unique cars
• Race the way you want! By popular demand you can now touch or tilt to steer
• Use Mods to enhance your car and get ahead of the pack in style
• Experience the action with mind-blowing graphics and intense full-car damage 
• Earn Speed Points to unlock new cars

Your rivals will do everything they can to stop you from getting to the top – but in this world, there can only be one Most Wanted.

Requires acceptance of EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy and User Agreement.

name: Shadow Fight 2 Special Edition
description:
** New story chapter! **
** No Ads! **
** No energy! **

The best fighting series on mobile has returned and become even more SPECIAL - Shadow Fight 2 Special Edition!! 

Now it's your turn to meet Titan in person and put an end to his terror. Walk through the Gates of Shadows into the dangerous world full of memorable fights and brave heroes. These lands are waiting for a risky adventurer to appear and save them from the oppression of a sinister invader from another dimension! Discover a thrilling mix of two world's most popular game genres - Fighting & RPG. Gather a huge arsenal of lethal weapons, combine your gear and upgrade dozens of skills and moves!

- No Ads!
- No energy restoring. Jump into the fray anytime and anywhere you want!
- Unveil a truth behind Sensei's past in a whole new story chapter!
- Complete the story mode without grinding!
- Equip yourself with a huge amount of weapons and armor. Get a lot of gems through battles and make your arsenal even more larger!
- Travel across 7 distinct provinces and force to terrify Titan himself!
- Simple controls is designed for touch screen usage. Shadow Fight 2 is easy to play but hard to master!
- Astonishing animations and unique design!

You must have an internet connection for a verification check (only for the first launch).

name: 8-Bit Solitaire
description:
Why does every solitaire app bury a simple deck of cards under ads, coins, streaks, and spinning prize wheels?

This is just solitaire.

• Classic Klondike — draw one or draw three
• Crisp 8-bit pixel art on a clean, dark table
• No ads. Ever.
• No account, no tracking, no notifications begging you to come back
• Nothing to buy — everything's included

BUILT FOR ONE HAND
• The whole board sits mid-screen, right where your thumb lives — no stretching to the top corners
• Left- and right-handed layouts: the deck, pause, and undo all flip to your side
• Tap to move — no fiddly dragging. One tap sends a card where it should go.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Difficulty modifiers: draw three, kings-only empty columns, locked foundations, undo on or off — stricter rules multiply your score
• Winnable-deals-only mode, or gamble on a true random shuffle
• Dead-end detection calls the game the moment it can't be won — no wasting time on an unwinnable deal

THE DETAILS
• Undo, restart a deal, auto-finish a won game
• Local top-10 scores with time and difficulty
• Fireworks when you win. The cards drip off the table when you lose.

No missions. No coins. No timers. Just a good-looking deck of cards.

name: Gothic Classic
description:
Experience the award-winning masterpiece that revolutionized roleplaying games. Return to the penal colony of Khorinis in the iconic, dark-fantasy RPG that pioneered fully simulated open worlds.

Gothic redefined the genre by introducing a completely seamless, living ecosystem where every non-player character follows a strict 24-hour daily routine. Watch citizens work, eat, sleep, and dynamically react to your actions in a world that operates independently of your presence.

Thrown into a lawless prison under an impenetrable magical barrier, you begin as an absolute nobody. In this brutal environment, you must quickly secure raw power and make critical political choices to survive.

Align with one of three distinct convict factions, each boasting their own political agendas and unique armours. Your decisions actively reshape the balance of power inside the colony and dictate your ultimate path to freedom.

Master a revolutionary, hands-on progression system that eschews abstract menus. Seek out physical trainers in the wilderness to learn combat stances that visually evolve your fighting style from awkward recruit to lethal master.

OPTIMISED FOR MOBILE
* Tailor-Made Touch Controls: Navigate the rugged terrain and engage in high-stakes combat with layout options crafted specifically for touch screens.
* Gamepad Compatibility: Connect your favourite controller for a high-precision, traditional console gameplay experience.
* Cloud Saves & Game Center: Protect your progress across devices and track your accomplishments on the go.

name: Max Payne Mobile
description:
Max Payne, the award-winning title is now available for iOS.

A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Max Payne is a relentless story-driven game about a man on the edge, fighting to clear his name while struggling to uncover the truth about his slain family amongst a myriad of plot-twists. 

The groundbreaking original cinematic action-shooter, Max Payne introduced the concept of Bullet Time® in videogames. Through its stylish slow-motion gunplay combined with a dark and twisted story, Max Payne redefined the action-shooter genre.

Universal App:
Max Payne is supported on iPhone 3GS, iPhone 4, iPhone 4S, iPod Touch 4, iPad 1, iPad 2, the new iPad.

Features:
• Max Payne's signature slow motion gunplay, Bullet Time® 
• Stunningly sharp, HD quality resolution and textures
• Retina supported resolution for the new iPad
• Gameplay tailored for touch screen devices
• Highly customizable controls 
• Multiple aiming modes 
• Rockstar Games Social Club integration to track stats, unlock cheats and more*

*Rockstar Games Social Club supported on the iPhone4, iPhone 4S, iPad 2 and the new iPad only. Cheats are still accessible on older devices. 

For those using the "Skip to Level" cheat, we recommend that you have weapons in your inventory; as you  will start a new level with your current weapon set.  

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian and Japanese.

Mobile Version developed by War Drum Studios
www.wardrumstudios.com  

Find out more:
www.rockstargames.com 

See videos:
www.youtube.com/rockstargames 

Follow us: 
www.faceboook.com/rockstargames
www.twitter.com/rockstargames

name: Rebel Inc.
description:
Can you stop the Insurgency? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique and deeply engaging political/military strategic simulation. 

The war is ‘over’ - but we all know that doesn’t mean anything. To stabilise the country, you need to balance military and civilian priorities to win the hearts and minds of the people, whilst also stopping insurgents from seizing power!

Rebel Inc. is the brand new game from the creator of ‘Plague Inc.’ - one of the most popular paid games ever with over 200 million players. Brilliantly executed with beautiful graphics and critically acclaimed gameplay - Rebel Inc. offers a deeply engaging, strategic challenge inspired by the complexities and consequences of modern counter insurgency.

◈◈◈ #1 top paid game globally ◈◈◈

▶ “Rebel Inc. lets everyone wrestle with the messy challenges of post-conflict recovery and better understand the complex realities of building peace.” - World Bank Global Lead for Stability, Peace and Security
▶ "Highly rewarding spiritual sequel to one of the App Store's biggest hits." - Pocket Tactics
▶ "Surprisingly sophisticated... even better than some of the stabilization training software I have seen in government use" - PAXsims
▶ "Rebel Inc. is fascinating and fun" - 148Apps.com
▶ "Another great game and a worthy successor to Plague Inc" - App Store review
▶ "If you love strategy games then this is the game for you" - App Store review
▶ "Brilliant game, the gameplay is interesting and the strategy is intuitive!" - App Store review
▶ "Unlike anything I’ve played on here before" - App Store review

◈◈◈

Features:
● Stabilise 10 richly modeled regions
● Innovative representation of counter insurgency tactics 
● Fund realistic initiatives to empower the local government
● Highly detailed, hyper-realistic world based on extensive research
● Intelligent strategic and tactical AI
● Sophisticated narrative algorithms shaped by your decisions
● 9 unique governors with radically different abilities
● Conduct large-scale Operations in Campaign mode
● Play new generated Challenges every week
● 23 Official Scenarios including disease outbreaks, helicopters and advanced insurgents
● Comprehensive in-game help and tutorial system
● Full Save/Load functionality
● Internet connectivity not required

An important note:
Although a fictional game, Rebel Inc. looks at important real world issues and we have made every effort to deal with them sensitively. The game has been extensively researched and has been developed in cooperation with leading regional politicians, business people and journalists as well as international charities, experts and governments.

Special sale price to celebrate the launch of the game!

◈◈◈

I’ve got lots of plans for updates! Get in touch and let me know what you want to see.
James (the designer)

Contact me here:
www.ndemiccreations.com/en/1-support

name: Reporter 2
description:
The  continuation  of the popular action-horror  game - "Reporter" from "AGaming+" studio, will shock you to the core! Turn off the lights, connect headphones and be careful, because only the attentive and  cautious person can finally unravel this dark history!

   You somehow miraculously survived in the hospital! Do you think it is over? And what about that strange call about 7 days? The time is running out! Carefree dreams are left behind: now you are hostage of nightmares and wake up in a cold sweat every morning. And nightmares are becoming more realistic and eerie every day. That's why you are trying to find out something about that mysterious girl, who is following you in nightmares. One of your friends found out something interesting and you need to start your action, immediately! It's time to go!

name: Peace, Death!
description:
Peace, Death! is an arcade simulator with difficulties. In this game, you play as the Reaper working for your boss, Death, in Apocalypse, Inc. You face a challenge: go through a trial period of seven weeks to get a permanent job and advance the interests of your employer.

Features.
You need to examine each client's feature to determine his, her, or its fate. There are more features every day and the game becomes more difficult. Your client holds a pistol? Send him to Hell unless he changes his mind and drops weapons. Is your client a hat-lover? Should you send him to Heaven? No, it's not that easy! First, take the hat off, and you might see the horns. Being a demon, killer, or an angel are features, too. 

Catastrophes.
These are unique events, they're unexpected and rapid, so Reaper is pressed by time. But you must allocate clients correctly to complete a catastrophe, unlock new clients and increase Death's influence! Unlucky pirates, bear influenza epidemic in Siberia, fighting for a free soup - these are only some of the catastrophes.

Events.
Each week you will face a new event. The more days you worked, the more events you have. Trainees' phone calls, safes with smuggled goods, undercover agents of Paradox, kidnappers. They all pose some difficulties but help you to become the best in the biz. Why, you can even cook a soup!

Theme Days.
Each seventh day is a theme day. You'll choose clients' fate for a unique soundtrack corresponding to the spirit of the chosen theme. Egypt? Certainly! Mother Russia? Nostrovia! Pirate day? Yo-ho-ho!

What else?
Horsemen tasks, funny clients' phrases, lots of references and easter eggs, bonuses, penalties, very special clients - all this will define your future as the Reaper determine the game ending!

Good luck, Reaper!

name: Incredibox
description:
Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy swing, Brazilian rhythms and much more. As well, discover a selection of mods created by the community. Plenty to keep you mixing for hours, with no ads or microtransactions.

Part game, part tool, Incredibox is above all an audio and visual experience that has quickly become a hit with people of all ages. The right mix of music, graphics, animation and interactivity makes Incredibox ideal for everyone. And because it makes learning fun and entertaining, Incredibox is now being used by schools all over the world.

How to play? Easy! Drag and drop icons onto the avatars to make them sing and start to compose your own music. Find the right sound combos to unlock animated choruses that will enhance your tune.

Once your composition sounds great, just save it and share it to get as many votes as possible. If you get enough votes, you may go down in Incredibox history by joining the Top 50 chart! Ready to show your stuff?

You can also download your mix as an MP3 from the app and listen to it over and over again!

Too lazy to create your own mix? No problem, just let the automatic mode play for you!

Pump it up and chill ;)

****************
Incredibox, the brainchild of Lyon, France-based studio So Far So Good, was created in 2009. Starting out as a webpage, it was then released as a mobile and tablet app and became an instant hit. It has won several awards and appeared in various international media, including: BBC, Adobe, FWA, Gizmodo, Slate, Konbini, Softonic, Kotaku, Cosmopolitan, PocketGamer, AppAdvice, AppSpy, Vice, Ultralinx and many others. The online demo has attracted more than 100 million visitors since its creation.

name: SK26: Street Kart Racing Game
description:
NOT FOR WIMPS. New Multiplayer PvP RIVALS feature added. SK26 is an online kart racing simulator for F1, Nascar and real-racing fans who want proper competition.  Download Now.

Race an inch from the track at speeds up to 80 mph (125 kph). 4 Tiers of Weekly Championships. No. 1 paid racing game over 100 countries! (App Annie). 

"You’ll never find another game like it. So competitive..."
Marijn Kremers, FIA-CIK World and European Kart Champion (KZ)

“I stopped real racing 3 as soon as I found this game.”
Mika Francis. App Store Review.

"If you like f1 or nascar games such as Assoluto Racing you'll love this."

Similar karts, similar engines. Always close, fast, competitive.  This is Street Kart Racing.

The road to f1 / nascar / indycar /  all starts in a kart. 

BRING IT ON
The original real racing sim game, SK is it. 

	⁃	The No.1 go kart game on mobile
        -       Awesome physics.
	⁃	Challenging, fun, rewarding.
	⁃	No Assists. No Excuses. Real racing tiers up to 80 mph.
	⁃	Tested for authenticity by hundreds of go kart - rally - stock car racing drivers including world champions. Even f1 drivers play it!

- YOUR GOAL -
Go Karts: All F1, nascar, indycar, rally drivers start in cadet Karts - and so do you:

	⁃	Race Real People on Real Tracks
	⁃	Beat EVERYONE to become world go kart champion
	⁃	Single & multiplayer competition

- SK DISCORD COMMUNITY -
Sure we’re on the grid to win. In the pits we all help each other out. 

	⁃	Tips, tricks, advice. 
	⁃	Create rivalries, join the banter, and always have someone to race. 

The no.1 go kart game on iOS.  Assoluto racing to go cart racers. Even F1 racing drivers play SK. 

www.facebook.com/groups/streetkartracing

- GO KARTING STRATEGY -
- WEATHER: If it is raining at the track in real life it is raining in the game. We simulate everything. Rain, drizzle, hot and cold temperatures affect tire choice and grip. Air pressure affects the power delivered by the engine, speed and your lap time. More thought than your average racing game.
- CHOICE: Like F1, Indycar, Gear Club or Nascar games - a range of tire compounds from different brands.
- RIVALRIES:  Win personal battles
- UPGRADES: Make complex kart choices: exhaust, seats, brakes, fuel, engines, tyre pressures and setup.. 

-----  KEY FEATURES -----
We’re the no.1 go kart game. Here’s why:
- Street Kart Racing is about epic rivalries against real people.
- Close: Race in closely matched go karts - none of this massive upgrade, automatic win! We race in tenths!
- Compete against pro racing drivers! Yes they play Street Kart Racing Game.
- Real Tracks. Our grid: PFI, Adria, Wackersdorf, Mariembourg, Las Vegas Todd Road, and many more. No F1 tracks here.

- KART RACING  -
Like Assoluto Racing - practice in solo mode with the 2018 World Champions Rosberg Racing Academy. Improve set ups and racing skills with test real racing lines. Test out different physics setups. 

RACE PASS SUBSCRIPTION - SUPPORT THE DEVS
By joining as an SK Race Pass Member, you are agreeing to an auto-renewing monthly subscription plan (unless auto-renew is turned off) that will automatically be charged every month through your iTunes account for $4.99 within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. You will be charged $4.99 for the first month immediately after your purchase is confirmed. To manage this subscription, or turn auto-renewal off, go to Account Settings after purchase.


Development Team
Street Kart Racing has ambassadors who race at the highest level of professional go kart racing / car / rally racing - helping perfect the racing game simulator physics. You'll find them on race tracks worldwide aiming to reach F1, Nascar, Indycar.

About Us
We’re a small team but we don't believe that should mean average. Your experience playing Street Kart Racing Simulator should be the most fun driving game on mobile.

https://www.streetkart.me/eula

name: Tokyo Train! 4
description:
Run Japanese Trains!
Dear Train Dispatchers, let's keep on departing regular and limited express trains to transport passengers.

"Tokyo Train! 4" can be enjoyed by anyone, whether you love trains or games. No specialized knowledge is required.

We have prepared more than 50 routes throughout Japan! There are also new routes.
(You can enjoy this game even if you have not played the previous games "Tokyo Train! 1/2/3".)

- For those who will become railway commanders
As a train commander, you can transport your customers by sending out various trains, such as local trains and express trains.

In this game, the theme is the evening rush hour in Japan. Transport your customers from terminal stations to stations in commuter towns. We have also made it possible to enjoy separate routes for Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka, and Fukuoka, so you can play from the route of your choice.

- Game goal
Transport your customers, collect fares, and aim for the highest operating profits!

Profit calculation formula
①	 Variable fare ― ② Ride time × ③ Number of passengers ― ④ Departure cost = ⑤ Operating profit

① Variable fare:
When the train transports passengers to the station where they will disembark, you will receive a fare. The fare will decrease over time. Also, the farther to the right the station is, the higher the fare.

② Ride time:
The ride time is displayed above the moving train. The ride time is deducted from the fare when the train transports passengers to the station where they will disembark. If you can transport passengers quickly, you can reduce the ride time.

③ Number of passengers
Each station shows how many passengers are on the destination.

④ Departure cost:
When the train departs, the departure cost is deducted.
The departure cost is displayed under the departure button.

⑤ Operating profit:
This is the goal of the game. Aim for great results!

Many express trains and Shinkansen trains appear in this game as well. In addition to the fare, these trains also charge "express charges" from customers. In order to pursue profits, it is very important to know how to operate express trains. 

・How to operate
The operation is very simple.
Just depart the train at the best timing.
You can operate up to 5 types of trains.

・Adjusting difficulty
Even if the route becomes complicated, the operation itself is easy until the end. By adjusting the difficulty at the information center, you can change the target number to clear the route.

・Plenty of volume
We have more than 50 railway routes available!

・New features of this game
You can now see the results of your operations on the timetable.
In addition to pursuing profits from operations, you can now enjoy looking at the wonderful timetable.

・Changes from the previous game
First of all, there is no need to consider the number of cars, and it is set that many passengers are already on at the terminal station.

Also, in this game, the fare charged from customers varies from station to station, and the more to the right the station, the more.
In this game, the fare is collected the moment the customer gets off the train.

The departure fee is set in detail and fixed for each line.

The concept of transfers has also been redesigned.
Until now, transfers were made by clicking the downward arrow on the route map, but in this game, transfers are made when a train waiting to pass at a siding station connects with an express train, allowing you to shorten the ride time of the train waiting to pass. In the previous game, transfers were from local trains to express trains, but in this game, transfers are from express trains to local trains.

- Capacity is about 130MB
The burden on storage is small. There is no heavy processing, so it is suitable for relatively old models.

Each game takes less than 3 minutes, so you can enjoy it casually.

- No ads, no in-app purchases
There are no in-app purchases. There are no ads.
Children can also enjoy it with peace of mind.

name: Scritchy Scratchy
description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:
• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching 
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

name: Farming Simulator 20
description:
Step into the exciting world of farming with Farming Simulator 20! Harvest many different crops, tend to your livestock of pigs, cows, and sheep, and now ride your own horses, letting you explore the vast land around your farm in a brand-new way. Sell your products in a dynamic market to earn money which you can invest in additional machinery and the expansion of your farm.

In Farming Simulator 20 you take control of over 100 vehicles and tools faithfully recreated from leading brands in the industry. For the first time on mobile platforms this includes John Deere, the largest agriculture machinery company in the world. Drive other famous farming brands such as Case IH, New Holland, Challenger, Fendt, Massey Ferguson, Valtra, Krone, Deutz-Fahr and many more.

Farming Simulator 20 features a new North American environment in which to develop and expand your farm. Enjoy many exciting farming activities, including new machinery and crops with cotton and oats. 


Features of Farming Simulator 20 include:

• Use over 100 realistic vehicles and tools from some of the biggest agriculture machine makers
• Plant and harvest different crops: Wheat, barley, oat, canola, sunflowers, soybean, corn, potatoes, sugar beet and cotton
• Feed your cows and sheep to produce and sell milk and wool
• Take care of horses and ride on them to freely explore the world around your farm
• New 3D graphics show even more detail on your machinery and the Northern American environment
• Cockpit view lets you drive in your vehicles in an even more realistic way than before

name: Little Nightmares
description:
Escape your childhood fears.

First available on PC and consoles, the horror adventure tale Little Nightmares is available on mobile!
 Immerse yourself in Little Nightmares, a dark whimsical tale that will confront you with your childhood fears!
Help Six escape The Maw – a vast, mysterious vessel inhabited by corrupted souls looking for their next meal.
As you progress on your journey, explore the most disturbing dollhouse offering a prison to escape from and a playground full of secrets to discover.
Reconnect with your inner child to unleash your imagination and find the way out!
Little Nightmares features a subtle mix of action and puzzle-platformer mechanics rooted in an eerie artistic direction and creepy sound design.
Sneak your way out of the Maw’s dreary maze and run from its corrupted inhabitants to escape your childhood fears. 

FEATURES

- Tiptoe your way through a dark and thrilling adventure
- Rediscover your childhood fears inside a haunting vessel and escape its eerie inhabitants
- Climb, crawl and hide through nightmarish environments to solve tricky platform puzzles
- Immerse yourself in the Maw through its creepy sound design

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE

- Revamped interface
- Game Center achievements
- Compatible with MFi controllers

If you run into a problem, please contact us at https://playdigious.helpshift.com/hc/en/12-playdigious/ with as much information as possible on the issue.

name: Z.O.N.A Project X
description:
Z.O.N.A Project X - first person shooter based in a post-apocalyptic world.

Action of the game takes place in a near future time, where almost all of mankind was destroyed with the nuclear weapon's. The earth became unsuitable for normal existence. Only one group of survivor's fight to survive in this hostile and dangerous world and you are one of them! The future of all the mankind depends on you, are you up for the challenge?

Unpredictable plot, great graphics with lots of different of weapons, Bloodthirsty monsters and greedy thugs - this is what awaits you in the Z.O.N.A Project X!

name: Aerofly FS Global
description:
Aerofly FS Global is one of the most sophisticated Flight Simulators for your mobile device, suitable for beginner and professional flight sim pilots alike. Explore the world of flying with extremely detailed and accurately simulated airliners, fully interactive 3D cockpits and realistic aircraft systems. Fly with complex airliners, helicopters, business jets, fighter jets and warbirds, general aviation aircraft, aerobatic stuntplanes and gliders across the photorealistic landscape.

IMPORTANT NOTE: The level of graphics details depends on your device performance and memory.

▶ AIRCRAFT
8 aircraft included in the base app:
• Airbus A320, Dash 8-Q400, Learjet 45, Cessna 172, Baron 58, Aermacchi MB339, F-15E Strike Eagle, Jungmeister

Over 30 more aircraft available as in-app purchases, like Airbus A350, Airbus A380, Boeing B777, Boeing B787,  F/A-18 Hornet, Concorde, UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter, CRJ-900 and many more

▶ DEFAULT SCENERY
Included scenery in the base product: 
• US west coast from Sacramento to Monterey including the San Francisco Bay Area region 
• Detailed custom made airports

▶ GLOBAL SCENERY
IMPORTANT NOTE: The global scenery streaming service requires a working internect connection
Explore the world with our global scenery streaming! Global streaming is available as prepaid subscription and adds world wide scenery coverage and other global features:
• Global high-res aerial images and elevation data
• Global 3D buildings, objects and points of interest (on selected and powerful devices)
• Global night lighting
• 2000+ hand made airports
• 6000+ global airports
• 10,000+ missions based on real world flights
• 100+ hand crafted flight missions

▶ SIM FEATURES
• Pushback
• High resolution aerial images
• 3D buildings and terminals
• Dynamic aircraft lights (on selected and powerful devices)
• Optional Flight assistance with simulated copilot
• Global air traffic simulation with optional flight-paths and labels
• Instant replay with option to resume flight from that recorded state
• Go back in time and try again after a crash
• Skip forward in time along the route
• Instant selection of cold and dark, before engine start, ready for taxi, ready for takeoff, on final approach and cruise configurations
• Personal flight statistics, achievements, career progress and recorded flight paths
• Adjustable time of day
• Configurable clouds
• Adjustable wind speed, thermals and turbulence
• Various camera views in the cockpit, passenger views, external views, tower views, fly-by and more
• Optional landmark labels for mountains, lakes and cities

▶ AIRCRAFT FEATURES
• Realistic flight physics
• Fully simulated landing gear physics
• Fully simulated wing flex (not just an animation) on nearly all aircraft
• Independent simulation of all flight control actuators and flight control surfaces
• Cold and Dark option and engine start procedures in all aircraft, except after-burning jets
• Highly detailed, animated and interactive 3D cockpits
• Highly sophisticated autopilot and flight-management system
• Realistic fly-by-wire simulations
• Realistic instrument navigation (ILS, NDB, VOR, TCN)
• Interactive flight management systems (FMS)
• Real-time landing lights and other exterior lights that illuminate the ground (on selected and powerful devices)
• Realistic internal lighting

See full details per aircraft: https://www.aerofly.com/features/aircraft/

Privacy policy: https://www.aerofly.com/privacy

End User License Agreements (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Human: Fall Flat
description:
Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 4 players. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded. Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded.

MORE HUMANS, MORE MAYHEM - Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 4 players transforms the way Human Fall Flat is played.

MIND BENDING PUZZLES - Explore open-ended levels full of challenging puzzles and hilarious distractions. Try new paths and discover all the secrets!

A BLANK CANVAS - Your Human is yours to customize. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colors!

FREE GREAT CONTENT - Since launch more than four brand new levels have launched free of charge with even more on the horizon. What could the next dreamscape have in store?

A VIBRANT COMMUNITY - Streamers and YouTubers flock to Human Fall Flat for its unique, hilarious gameplay. Fans have watched these videos more than 3 Billion times!

name: Ala Mobile
Vector Classic
description:
The best parkour-inspired action game is now available! Vector lets you break free and run! Don't get caught!

Vector is an exciting, arcade-style game featuring you as the exceptional free runner who won’t be held down by the system. The game opens with a view into a totalitarian world where freedom and individually is nothing more than a distant dream. But the heart of a freerunner is strong, and you soon break free. Run, vault, slide and climb using extraordinary techniques based on the urban ninja sport of Parkour all while being chased by “Big Brother” who’s sole purpose is to capture you and bring you back.

Inspired by the practice and principles of Parkour, Vector’s intuitive controls please players of all levels, and sophisticated level designs challenge the most demanding players with fast-paced timing puzzles as the traceur “flows” over the dystopian rooftops.

Game Features:
- Arcade gameplay from the makers of the Shadow Fight games
- Astoundingly lifelike Parkour-inspired moves made possible by Cascadeur animation tools
- 40+ challenging levels
- Quick to learn, challenging to master

The Press Loves Vector:

“The way Vector mimics the movements of real-life parkour practitioners is quite impressive... I can’t wait to be entrapped in Vector’s promising mix of direction and magnitude.” (appadvice.com)

 “Vector is thrilling, rich in variety and it reminds us of Stick Run, but offers much more elaborate animations.” (fbgamer.de)

"The only cool way to run from all your problems." (Gamezebo.com)

name: Duty Court
description:
Put on your robe, judge — the courtroom is waiting for you!

Duty Court is a fast-paced judicial simulation game set in a bustling courtroom. Every defendant who stands before you is in your hands. Will you deliver the right verdict and uphold justice, or will you make a critical mistake?

THOROUGH INVESTIGATION
Take witness testimonies, review security camera footage, and conduct cross-examinations. Every piece of evidence carries weight.

ADVANCED TOOLS
Use forensic reports, phone records, and a lie detector to uncover the truth — but choose wisely, you only get 2 actions per case.

CRITICAL DECISIONS
Release the defendant, impose probation, or order arrest. Every call affects your lives and reputation — one wrong move can end your career.

THE BRIBE TRAP
Some defendants will offer you money to look the other way. Accept and your reputation crumbles. Staying clean is hard — but rewarded.

CHALLENGING 15-DAY CAREER
Harder cases, trickier defendants, and more complex evidence every single day. Experience real courtroom pressure as difficulty scales to the max.

Step into the seat of justice and prove you're the courtroom's finest judge!

name: Taboo
description:
Can you describe an APPLE without using the words RED, FRUIT, PIE, CIDER or CORE?

Taboo is the ultimate brain-teasing, word-twisting adult party game. Play with video chat and throw a house party on your phone! Split into two teams and take it in turns to describe the words on the cards. Your team has to guess as many as possible before the timer runs out. 

If you use a taboo word by mistake, the other team will buzz and you’ll lose a point. 

Think fast and talk your way to victory!

HOW TO PLAY TABOO: 
1. Start a game and invite your friends. 
2. Split into two teams and name your team.
3. The app chooses a Clue-giver for each team. Each team then takes their turn!
4. The Clue-giver draws a card. The Clue-giver must describe the word without saying any of the words on the card.
5. Team B will buzz if the Clue-giver says a taboo word!
6. Your team must guess as many words as possible before the time runs out.

FEATURES
- FULLY CUSTOMISABLE – Decide the number of players, rounds, how many turns per round and how many skips are allowed.
- AD-FREE GAME – Have fun with zero ads to distract you.
- COMPLETE STARTER CARD DECK – Includes cards from the original game. Expand your game further with additional themed decks!
- FULLY TRANSLATED – Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Greek, Polish and Hindi.

Get the perfect party game on your mobile now!

name: Control Ultimate Edition
description:
A corruptive presence has invaded the Federal Bureau of Control… Only you have the power to stop it. The world is now your weapon in an epic fight to annihilate an ominous enemy through deep and unpredictable environments. Containment has failed, humanity is at stake. Will you regain control?


Winner of over 80 awards, CONTROL is a visually stunning third-person action-adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Blending open-ended environments with the signature world-building and storytelling of renowned developer, Remedy Entertainment, CONTROL presents an expansive and intensely gratifying gameplay experience.


CONTROL Ultimate Edition has now been adapted to iOS. We have implemented touch controls and made changes to the in-game UI and game mechanics, like aiming and puzzles to provide a great experience for supported touch devices. The game renders beautifully through Metal and supports Ray Tracing on supported hardware.



Key features


UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES: Can you handle the bureau’s dark secrets? Unfold an epic supernatural struggle, filled with unexpected characters and bizarre events, as you search for your missing brother, and discover the truth that has brought you here.



EVERYTHING IS YOUR WEAPON: Unleash destruction through transforming weaponry and telekinetic powers. Discover new ways to annihilate your enemies as you harness powerful abilities to turn everything around you into a lethal weapon.



EXPLORE A HIDDEN WORLD: Delve deep into the ominous expanses of a secretive government agency. Explore the Bureau’s shifting environments only to discover that there is always more than meets the eye…



FIGHT FOR CONTROL: Battle a relentless enemy through exciting missions and challenging boss fights to earn powerful upgrades that maximize abilities and customize your weaponry.


CONTROL Ultimate Edition on iOS supports the following MetalFX features:

MetalFX TAAU - Temporal Anti-Aliasing and upscaling
MetalFX Frame Interpolation

Ray-Tracing is supported on devices with M3+ or A19 Pro with 10Gb of memory.

name: This Aint Even Poker, Ya Joker
description:
Welcome to This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker - a unique incremental idle clicker where you flip cards to earn money, grow your hand, buy new decks, unlock powerful upgrades, discover new cards, and more. Can you defeat the Jester and escape the carnival?
Steam: Very Positive, 89%

GROW YOUR HAND
Buy new cards to increase your odds of hitting good hands. If you're rich enough, you can even break the rules and get over 5 cards.

ESTABLISH DOMINANCE
Even though the Jester doesn't like it, you can buy new decks of cards in order to play more hands at once. Use this to your advantage to grow those numbers even faster!

GET UPGRADED
Buy powerful upgrades using your hard earned coins, enabling you to progress quicker, open up new avenues, and take on the evil Jester!

GO ON EXPEDITIONS
Once unlocked, you can send your minions on expeditions to discover new otherworldy cards with powerful benefits. Upgrade these missions to provide even more powerful benefits as you progress. You can even unlock missions to destroy cards from your deck that you don't want, to ensure every hand is exactly how you want it.

ASCEND TO GREATNESS
Make a deal with the Jester to start over in exchange for Poker Chips (poker chips? But this ain't even poker...?), use those chips to buy even more powerful upgrades.

ESCAPE THE HOUSE OF CARDS
You're trapped in the Jester's domain, can you manage to defeat him and escape? Or will he keep you there, trapped forever in an endless cycle?

name: TABS Pocket Edition
description:
Be the leader of red and blue wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created. 

When you grow tired of the 100+ wobblers at your disposal you can make new ones in the unit creator.

You can also send your wobblers to fight your friends or strangers in online multiplayer!

Features:

    -Campaigns
    -Multiplayer
    -Sandbox mode
    -Unit Possession
    -A bunch of silly units

name: 放置江湖：隐世门派现武林
description:
《放置江湖》是一款武侠风格高自由度的角色扮演，冒险游戏。

江湖五载，风起云涌。重光入侵，烽火连天，武林动荡，血雨腥风！
《放置江湖》七周年之际，江湖中有一股神秘组织力量名为重光教的教派，他们一边不断地发展壮大，一边开始威胁到中原的各大门派，以让重光教一统江湖，江湖中人人自危。武林动荡时局已定，我等特邀诸位侠士齐聚江湖，联手抗敌！
侠之大者，为国为民，群英荟萃，歃血为盟......
新资料片“重光入侵”强势来袭！

=====七周年版本更新内容=====
（以下为整个暑期7月-8月版本更新内容，具体更新日期依据游戏内公告为准）

【全新剧情】
※更新《重光入侵》全新剧情、支线剧情和日常任务。

【新版战斗及多人战斗】
※新增多人对多人的战斗，战场上同时存在多个目标。
※新增多目标武学招式，可同时影响多个目标。
※新增防御反击，某些武学可以通过反击打断对方当前攻击招式。
※调整核心战斗机制，伤害机制更趋向平衡。
※调整轻功及招架战斗机制。
※修复部分战斗BUG。

【江湖笔录】
※新增江湖笔录系统，根据笔录内容会逐步引导学习与探索整个放置江湖的玩法。

【先贤书案】
※新增先贤书案，玩家在传承前可以透过先贤书案，把自身学会的武学记录，便于后人在传承后付出一定条件进行学习。
(书案记录是终身记录，不需要多次重复记录。)

【烂柯棋局】
※新增烂柯棋局玩法，玩家可以透过此棋局提前体验新版战斗里面的全新内容，并且使用指定门派提前体验突破后的武学形态。
（烂柯棋局中玩家也可以获得梦境呓语。）

【五周年称号】
※玩家可以通过五周年彩蛋任务，进入彩蛋副本处获得五周年纪念称号。

【神兵优化】
※玩家可以锻造并容纳更多神兵。

【江湖情报】
※新增关于周年庆内容相关的江湖情报和小技巧。

【面具升级】
※新增升级面具，玩家可以对部分指定面具进行升级，升级后的面具会变得更加华丽。
（李魔头面具重绘更新上线。）

【其他优化及更新内容】
※新增平安小镇日常任务。
※优化界面切换卡顿问题。
※优化书箱卡顿问题。


评价:
——“前期功能看似很少，可随着一步一步了解游戏，解锁功能后才发现，这个游戏太丰富、大庞大了！！”
——“不是简单的放置类游戏，也不是无脑卡牌游戏，这样的武侠太少了，光凭这两点就值得一试。”
——“我坚持玩了5分钟，然后几个小时就过去了。”
——“游戏内战斗的对白和招式挺有意思的，很有武侠小说的感觉。”
——“看腻了各种仙侠，修真，真的有点审美疲劳，还是这种纯武侠味的更真实更有血性。”

=====游戏特色=====
* 依凭文字游走江湖。细心探索NPC对话，发掘隐藏任务，揭秘NPC小秘密，江湖的故事绝不止一点。
* 28个门派任君选择，更有一些隐藏门派等你发现。 
* 几百种武功应有尽有。镇派绝学、江湖武学，更有绝世神功等待有缘人。
* 海量地图，构造一个庞大的江湖，行走江湖无止境。
* 简化基础成长，离线也能练功。想快人一步？没问题，有更丰富的事件等你解决。
* 打造属于自己的专属兵器。起一个帅气的名字，让它和你一起名扬天下。
* 江湖会因为你的行为而产生改变。如果你杀死了NPC，那可要小心NPC的后代复仇噢。
* 江湖之大，穷尽一生也走不完。当岁月催人时，你可以选择退隐江湖，而以自己的后人的身份继续游戏，而江湖上到处都是过去你的传说。
* 开启家园，在江湖中建一间大宅，有一方偏安江湖之隅。招募门客、怪客拜访，多种玩法，等你前来。
* 自创武学，成就一代宗师，问名江湖天下无敌。
* 梦境，光怪陆离，一梦犹如人生百年，体验不一样的江湖。


=====历史更新=====
【家园系统】
*新购屋宅，在江湖中种田耕农、招募门客，何不快哉。

【跨服副本】
*和来自不同江湖的人士比武论剑，到底谁才是真正的天下第一。

【新章节剧情】
*铁掌海鲸摩擦不断，各派人士蠢蠢欲动，朝廷江湖牵扯不断，到底谁才是搅弄武林的真正黑手？只要顺藤摸瓜，江湖隐秘必将大白天下。

【师门地图】
*各门各派都拥有了属于自己的地盘，同门切磋、挑战师父，全新师门任务等你开启。

【科举考试】
*从乡试、省试、殿试一步步成长，一展才华，金榜题名。

【制作组】
*挑战游戏制作组的机会来了！全新地图，全新任务，彩蛋等你发现。

【自创武学】
*自创属于自己的专属武学，开创属于自己的打法流派。

【梦境】
*一门与梦相关的武功。种种谜团，纷繁往事，皆等少侠在梦境之中。
