* Play daily goals and get free dice, coins and diamonds
* New Quick Ludo Mode available
* Voice Chat available

Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Parchisi, a game played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the dice to play and move your tokens to reach the center of the board. Beat the other players to become the Ludo King. Play this dice game Ludo King. Best casual game in board games.

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). People also misspell Ludo as Loodo, Lido, Lado, Ledo, Leedo, Laado, or Lodo. 

Ludo's versions are Trouble, Sorry, Aeroplane chess, Chopat, Chaupur, Pachisi or Parcheesi.

Features of Ludo King:
•	No internet connection required! Play against the computer.
•	Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer.
•	Play with 2 to 6 Players in Local Multiplayer Mode.
•	Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a Private Game Room and beat them to become Ludo King.
•	Play with world players and make them your buddies.
•	Private Chat with your Facebook friends & Buddies.
•	Play Snake and Ladders on 7 different gameboards.
•	Simple rules which can be followed by players of all ages.

Play the game of Kings with your family and friends. While the gameplay might seem simple at first, the game is immensely enjoyable and challenging. It’s fun for the whole family; You’ll be playing this one for hours. Try to beat your opponents and compete for the highest scores on the leaderboards.

How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines? Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

name: Arrow Puzzle - Arrows Game
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

- In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
- Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
- Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others.
- Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
- If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
- Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and enjoy the moment when the last arrow leaves and everything falls into place.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

• A minimalist arrow game with simple rules and deep strategy—easy to start, satisfying to master.
• Hundreds of handcrafted tap away style puzzles that grow in challenge as you play.
• Daily Challenges—play every day, complete monthly challenges, and collect unique trophies.
• Helpful hints when you need a small nudge to release an arrow and keep the flow going.
• No timer, no pressure—a relaxing escape and a true delight for your mind.
• Clean, calming visuals and smooth animations that keep the focus on puzzle-solving in this tap game.

Play Arrow Puzzle, clear the grid of arrows, and enjoy a rare balance of sharp focus and deep relaxation.

Play the world's best bird flinging, pig popping game!

Use the slingshot to fling birds at the piggies' towers and bring them crashing down – all to save the precious eggs.

New to the world of Angry Birds? Angry Birds 2 is the best way to get to know all of the iconic characters and experience the fun gameplay that has captured the hearts (and spare time) of millions of players.

Decorated Angry Birds veteran? Everything you love about classic Angry Birds games is here with some awesome new additions. Choose which bird to fling when, play with friends, take on multi stage levels, and compete and collaborate with players around the globe.

● CHOOSE YOUR BIRD. Choose which bird to put in the slingshot and defeat the pigs with strategy!  
● MULTI-STAGE LEVELS. Play fun, challenging levels with multiple stages – just watch out for those Boss Pigs!  
● DAILY CHALLENGES. Have a minute? Complete a daily challenge and earn some quick rewards.  
● LEVEL UP your birds with feathers and up their scoring power. Build the ultimate flock!   
● JOIN A CLAN to take down the pigs with friends and players around the world.  
● IMPRESS THE MIGHTY EAGLE in Mighty Eagle's Bootcamp and earn coins to use in his exclusive shop.  
● COMPETE in the ARENA. Compete with other players for some friendly bird flinging fun and prove who is the best.  
● COLLECT SILLY HATS. Collect hats with different fun themes and level up your birds' fashion game.  
● BAD PIGGIES. The green baddies are back, stronger, badder, and even greener.  
● LOTS OF LEVELS. Play hundreds of levels with more added in regular updates and limited time events.  
● LEADERBOARDS. Prove who is the best in the world on the global leaderboards.  
● FREE to download!

name: Kingshot
description:
Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

name: Rankwise Card Puzzles
description:
Rankwise Card Puzzles is a brain-training card game built on a standard 52-card deck.
Its three games each ask something different of the same cards: to see
connections, to hold what you just saw, and to work out a rule nobody
told you.

Runs last two to five minutes. Every one is scored, and every number the
app shows about you is one you earned — there is no pre-filled progress
anywhere in it.

For anyone who wants a sharp, short test of skill: puzzle players, card
players, and anyone who enjoys being made to think quickly.


FEATURES
--------
• Three original games, all played on the same 52 cards.
    - Sigil Path — trace a glowing line through a spread of 24 cards.
    - Mind's Eye — a hand appears once, then asks you what was in it.
    - Cipher — five cards follow a hidden rule; name the missing one.

• Performance Table — your progress seen at a glance, with accuracy,
  streak, consistency and sessions all tracked.

• Hand Legacy — eight collectible moments that gild as you earn them.

• Daily Orders — three tasks a day, one for each game, new at midnight.

• Six ranks, Newcomer to Luminary, earned across all three games.

• A daily streak that counts the days you turned up.

• Score multipliers that climb with every success and reset on a miss.

• Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no purchases, and no timers
  asking you to come back later.


HOW TO PLAY
-----------
1. Tap PLAY, then choose one of the three games.
2. Read the one-line rule on the ready screen and tap BEGIN.
3. Play the run. Your score, multiplier and progress sit in the top bar.
4. At the end, review your result and either play again or step back out.

SIGIL PATH
  Drag a line from card to card. Two cards join if they share a suit, or
  if their ranks sit next to each other — the ace joins both the two and
  the king. Release to cast: the line clears and the spread refills.
  Three cards is the shortest sigil worth casting. Length is scored
  squared, so one long line is worth far more than several short ones.
  A path in a single suit, or one climbing in a straight run, scores
  double. You get 15 casts per run.

MIND'S EYE
  A hand is dealt face up. Hold it. The cards turn over, and only then
  does the question arrive: which card was there, which was missing,
  what sat in third place, how many of a suit went by. Choose one of
  four answers before the ring empties. Ten rounds, with the hands
  growing and the glimpse getting shorter each time.

CIPHER
  Five cards follow a rule you are not told, and one of them is face
  down. Ranks may climb, fall, or double back; suits may hold, alternate,
  or turn in order — and two rules can run at once on alternating cards.
  Choose the card that completes the sequence. The rule is then named
  for you, whether you found it or not. Ten rounds.


BENEFITS
--------
• Trains three different skills — pattern recognition, short-term memory,
  and logical deduction — instead of one repeated reflex.

• Purely a game of skill. Nothing is left to chance, there is nothing to
  buy, and no advantage can be waited for.

• Cipher teaches as you go: it names the rule after every round, so a
  wrong answer still leaves you sharper for the next one.

• Honest progress. Rank, accuracy, streaks and records are all counted
  from your own runs, so every figure means exactly what it says.

• Daily Orders spread play across all three games, so no skill is left
  to go rusty.

• Fits a short break. A full run takes minutes, and your record stays
  on your own device.

name: Kulfi: Games for Couples
description:
You talk to them every day. And still, by 10pm, you're both just trading reels and typing "kya kar rahe ho" for the ninth time. You're not fighting. You're not bored of each other. You're just out of things to do.

Nobody warns you about this part of loving someone in India. A lot of us don't share a city, forget a room. The whole relationship lives inside a phone. Two grey ticks, a few voice notes, one call before bed. So much love stuck inside a very small screen.

Three of us built Kulfi, and we were all in the same spot. Long-term partners we love, who make our day. But once the day's been talked through, it all starts to repeat. What we missed wasn't the conversation, it was their presence. We didn't want to sit alone at night scrolling Instagram. We wanted to be in the same room as them, even when we couldn't. Half our video calls were just silence, nothing left to say. And it wasn't only us. Almost everyone we knew was in the same quiet.

Here's the only promise we care about: no couple on Kulfi should have a boring conversation again. We take that dead late-night chat and turn it into banter, teasing, a bit of fighting, and a lot of "wait, that's not fair."

Kulfi doesn't work like anything you've played. The games run across two phones, yours and theirs, at once. Some split the controls between you, so it's one game, one boat, each holding one half. Mess up your side and you both go down together.

Here's the part we love most. It's made for when you're already on a call. Put Kulfi on while you're on a video or audio call at night, and play straight through it. You're on the call anyway. This is what you do during it.

One house rule. No singles allowed. You invite your partner, send them a code, they punch it in, and you're paired. Till then, the games stay locked. Sounds a bit harsh, but that's the point. Kulfi is a two-person club, and if you're inside it, you've already got the one thing it asks for.

And you won't run dry. We add fresh games every single week. That's a founder promise, not a marketing line. We're trying to keep our own partners entertained, so trust me, the new stuff keeps coming.

Here's some of what's inside:

Pirate Escape
One boat, two captains. One wrong tap and you're both underwater. Stay in sync, or sink.

Snatch the Fries
The plate's between you and there was never enough. Grab fast. Love is conditional now.

Yeet the Spider
Aim, hold your nerve, fling it before the music stops. Don't ask, just throw.

Basketball Rivalry
Twenty seconds on the clock, zero mercy. Outscore them, or hear about it all night.

Four in a Row
Looks innocent. Ends relationships. Drop your coin, block theirs, act like you planned it.

Never Have I Ever
The cards ask, you answer honestly. Some answers you'll wish you could take back.

Who's More Likely To
You each lock in a guess. Then the reveal. Then the argument that lasts an hour.

Pillow Talk
The soft one. A quiet prompt, a real answer, the kind of 2am talk you don't get over text.


Underneath all of it, there's Roadtrip. The more you play, the more miles you and your partner rack up, and your little car moves further across the map. You unlock new cities, crack clues for what's next, and slowly take the road trip you keep saying you'll go on someday. Every other Kulfi couple is on that road too. You can't always meet. You can still go somewhere together.
One honest thing. Nearly every app you live on, Instagram, Snapchat, WhatsApp, was built somewhere else. India has over 200 million couples, and Kulfi is the couples app built in India, for India. We want it in the hands of every couple in the country.

So that's our ask. We built this to solve our own problem and sweated every detail. Download it, play it, and tell us honestly what's broken and what you loved. And please, spread the word. We're a young company, every download counts, and the fastest way Kulfi reaches the couple who needs it is you.

See you on the road,
The founders of Kulfi

HOW TO PLAY CALLBREAK?

New to trick-taking games? We've got you covered with step-by-step video tutorials right inside the app!

Callbreak (also known as Call Break, Lakadi, Lakdi, or Tash Game) is a skill-based card game played with a standard 52-card deck between 4 players. Each player receives 13 cards per round.
- BID - Look at your cards and predict how many tricks you'll win this round
- PLAY - Follow suit or use Spades (the trump suit) to win tricks and meet your bid
- WIN - Meet your bid to score points. Miss your bid and lose points!
- REPEAT - Play 5 rounds of 13 tricks each. The player with the highest score wins!

Callbreak is a beloved cultural classic across South Asia and around the world:
- Callbreak / Call Break / Call Bridge (Nepal, India, Bangladesh)
- Lakadi / Lakdi / लकड़ी (India)
- Tash Game / Tash Wala Game / तास खेल (Cards: patti / पत्ती / taas / तास)

Prepare for an exhilarating aerial adventure in Epic Plane Evolution, where your piloting skills and strategic upgrades determine how far your aircraft can soar. Launch your plane, navigate through diverse terrains, and evolve your aircraft to achieve maximum distance. Whether you're a casual gamer or a flight enthusiast, this game offers a captivating blend of action and strategy.


Epic Plane Evolution is a physics-based flight game that challenges players to launch their aircraft using a slingshot mechanism and guide it through various environments. As you progress, collect coins to upgrade your plane's components, enhancing its performance and unlocking new flight capabilities. Each level introduces unique challenges, requiring precise timing and strategic upgrades to succeed.



Slingshot Launch Mechanics
Initiate each flight by pulling back your plane on a slingshot, determining the initial speed and angle. Mastering this mechanic is crucial for achieving optimal flight paths and distances.


Aircraft Evolution and Upgrades
Accumulate coins during flights to invest in upgrades such as wings, engines, and fuselage enhancements. These improvements not only boost your plane's performance but also unlock new visual designs and capabilities.


Diverse Environments
Navigate through a variety of terrains, each presenting unique obstacles and weather conditions. Adapt your flight strategy to overcome challenges like wind currents, mountainous regions, and urban landscapes.


Strategic Flight Control
While airborne, adjust your plane's pitch and angle to maintain momentum and avoid obstacles. Strategic in-flight decisions can significantly impact your flight distance and coin collection.


Rewarding Progression System
Earn coins based on the distance traveled and successful navigation through obstacles. Use these earnings to continuously upgrade your aircraft, pushing the boundaries of how far you can fly.


Daily Challenges and Rewards
Engage in daily missions that offer additional rewards, encouraging consistent play and providing opportunities to test new strategies and upgrades.


Download and Take Flight!
Embark on your aviation journey today. Download Epic Plane Evolution and experience the thrill of launching, upgrading, and mastering the skies. How far can you fly?

name: Sensi Pro: Sensitivity & HUD
summary: Find, test and share your sensitivity, plus a live game HUD and on-device AI.
description:
Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play
• Suggests starting values and prints every rule it used next to the numbers
Values are a guide you type into your game's own menu. The app never touches a game.

TEST & CALIBRATE
• Three short drills inside the app: flick, track a moving ring, micro-adjust
• Measures overshooting, steadiness and precision, turns them into small per-row adjustments and counts your touch rate
• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES
• One profile free, three with VIP; every change is saved automatically
• Templates that mirror each game's menu layout: Free Fire-style, PUBG / BGMI-style, COD Mobile-style and a generic shooter layout
• Share a profile as a code or QR code and import a friend's, offline, no account
• VIP: a converter to another template or screen size, and a profile bound to each game

GAME HUD
A floating panel over the games you open from Sensi Pro, with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges with their thresholds
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, jitter and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus, keep awake, dim, screenshot, plus network, thermal status, battery and free RAM
• GAMES: your games one tap away
Outside a game it shrinks to a ping bubble. Hold it still or tap ✕ for the command wheel (finish the session, hide until your next game, switch off), or drag it to the bottom and drop it on a command. Each command has a 3-second undo.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: games from your list bring up the HUD however you start them, and it keeps each game's spot. Needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front. Without VIP, start games from Sensi Pro, its widget or a home-screen shortcut (3 free tries of Auto HUD)
• Auto setup for games started from Sensi Pro: Focus, keep screen on and dim, undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game

PRE-GAME
• Device Scan: one tap measures ping, jitter, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate. It changes no setting
• Focus Mode: Do Not Disturb for the match, lifted when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• Network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate your next ping
• AI Game Coach: add your games, start them from Sensi Pro and see sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips per game. Free plan: one game at a time; VIP: every game
Both run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested from your phone's RAM, cores and refresh rates, for you to set in the game
• Home-screen widget and a shortcut per game: one tap starts the game with the HUD
• Session report, weekly play time, break reminder
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

VIP (optional subscription)
New features first, Auto HUD, AI Game Coach for unlimited games, auto setup, AI alerts, the converter, profiles 2 and 3, screen recording from the HUD and the VIP mailbox to the Sensi team. Prices are shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Template names only describe each game's own menu layout; game names are trademarks of their owners and this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game. Some games have their own rules about on-screen overlays; check the rules of the game you play.

name: Game Mode Pro: Launcher & HUD
summary: Launch your games, watch live device readings, get a report after every session.
description:
Game Mode Pro is the paid edition of Game Mode: the same launcher and device-reading tools, its own interface, and no ads of any kind.

GAME LAUNCHER
Your games in one place: games are picked up automatically, anything else you add by hand. A game's home screen shortcut opens it through the app, HUD included, and a widget shows your most played game and the minute it usually dips.

LIVE HUD OVER YOUR GAME
With your permission, a small floating panel shows what Android reports while you play: free RAM, battery level and temperature, latency to a public DNS server, screen refresh rate. It does not show in-game FPS - no app can measure another app's frame rate - and it does not change how your game runs. Games started from the app or its shortcut get the panel; Auto HUD (VIP) opens it however a game starts.

A REPORT AFTER EVERY SESSION
Ping stability, free memory and battery temperature, with the raw numbers beside each score, plus playing time. It also shows what the network did: Wi-Fi signal and band, and the minute the signal went weak, the network changed or dropped, or the phone was moving a lot of data. Every session is kept.

AI GAME COACH - LEARNED FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
A model that runs entirely on your phone reads your recorded sessions: the minute your sessions with a game usually start to wobble, how long the battery lasts at that game's drain, and the time of day and network they held up best on. Two sessions of one game are enough to start. Nothing leaves your phone. These are predictions from your own history, not guarantees.

NETWORK CHECK
Measure: twenty round trips to a public DNS server, with the average, lowest, variation and unanswered samples. Wi-Fi · 4G/5G: both connections measured at the same time, side by side (uses a little mobile data). Regions: time to connect to cloud data centers in 13 regions, to pick a server region in a game's settings. It measures; it cannot change or switch your connection, and never reaches a game's server.

REMINDERS WHILE YOU PLAY
Optional, once per session each: your usual wobble minute, a hot or low battery, a phone already hot on the charger.

GAME MODE
Silences notifications while you play and, if you choose, calls too. It can also hold screen brightness, set media volume, keep the screen awake while Game HUD is on, and remind you to take a break. Give a game its own Game Mode, or skip it for that game. Everything it changes is restored when Game Mode ends; the brightness lock asks for "Modify system settings" first.

TEST KIT
Touch: how often the screen reports your finger, how many fingers it tracks, and a grid showing any spot that never registers. Display: the refresh rate now, the rates the screen supports, and a dead-pixel check. Controller: every button and both sticks, plus a stick-drift check. It only reads what the hardware reports.

REFLEX TRAINER - ROBOT RANGE
Robots pop up at three distances for 30 seconds; tap each before its ring closes. Three ranges open as you rank up, and the lobby replays the best 10 seconds of your record run. Timed from the frame a robot appears to your touch - it measures you, not the device.

GFX GUIDE
From your device's RAM, CPU, resolution and refresh rate, it suggests graphics, frame rate, resolution and shadows to set in the game yourself. It cannot change a game's settings or make it run faster.

VIP (optional subscription)
Auto HUD and Auto Game Mode for games opened from anywhere, plus six things your sessions make possible: a forecast of the next session, battery time left for this game, alerts that learn what is normal for your phone, change since your first sessions, a backup of your session log, and your records with a weekly report. Everything else above is in the purchase price.

10 languages, switchable in the app. "Display over other apps" and "Usage access" are only for the HUD and are asked for on the HUD screen; notification policy access is only for Do Not Disturb.

Smart Assist for Delivery uses the AccessibilityService API to provide essential assistive interactions for delivery partners living with motor impairments and physical disabilities.

How it works: 
For users with limited hand mobility or physical dexterity challenges, interacting with fast-paced, time-sensitive gig app interfaces to accept delivery orders can be highly difficult or completely exclusionary. This app utilizes the AccessibilityService API to detect incoming order windows and simulate a tap to accept them based on the user's pre-set preferences. This provides an equitable, assistive interaction layer so disabled users can participate in the gig economy independently.

Important Privacy Note: 
Our app strictly uses this API to facilitate screen automation for accessibility needs. We do not access, collect, track, or share any personal, sensitive, or identifiable user data.

🧠 BUILT FOR

Download Searcho and stop organising your home screen.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

Searcho includes optional features—Gestures & Screen Lock (navigation
shortcuts, motion gestures, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:

• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding system
actions, such as locking your screen or going Back, Home, Recents, or opening
Notifications and Quick Settings.
• Gesture Context: Reads the active application package name in real-time so
that a gesture performs the correct action for the app currently in the
foreground.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name to
determine which action applies. It does not record keystrokes, personal
details, or other screen content — it is declared without permission to
retrieve window content, so Android itself prevents this.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or transmitted.
All processing happens locally on your device, and Searcho does not hold the
INTERNET permission.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in Android
system settings.

Searcho is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.

• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
summary: Fly around the world! Pilot 3D airplanes and land at airports in this live sim!
description:
Your Ultimate Flight Simulation Experience on Mobile! Discover the thrill of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator, the most advanced flight simulation for mobile.

Whether you are a pro pilot or starting your journey into airplane games, RFS offers the most comprehensive experience. Pilot iconic aircraft, access global flights in real time, and explore ultra-realistic airports with live weather. This is the ultimate simulator for fans of plane games and flight simulation games.

Fly Anywhere in the World!
Take off from any part of the globe. Our flight simulator uses high-res satellite maps and 3D plane models to create a living world. Experience the unique sensation of being an airplane pilot as you navigate realistic topography. Fly through the world and explore detailed landmarks in your favorite 3D airplane.

60+ Aircraft Models – Take control of commercial, cargo, and military jets. From narrow-body airliners to massive jumbo planes, each aircraft features 3D live cockpits, FMC, and realistic lighting. New airplanes and planes are added regularly to our fleet!

1900+ HD Airports – Land your plane at detailed 3D airports with jetways and authentic taxiway procedures. Navigate busy terminals like a real pilot. Ground services include pushback, refueling, and catering for a complete airline experience.

Realistic Satellite Terrain – Fly over high-fidelity landscapes. Our technology provides accurate elevation data for every mountain and valley. Experience the most advanced landing simulator on mobile. Perfect for fans of realistic flight simulator gameplay.

Autopilot & Advanced Planning – Plan long-haul flights with precise autopilot, VNAV, LNAV, and ILS landing assistance. Customize weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots and explore the global aviation network.

Real Pilot Checklists – Master every stage of the flight. Follow authentic takeoff and landing procedures for total immersion in your pilot simulator. Use real-world protocols for every flight and plane mission.

Live Global Flights – Experience the world in real-time! Track over 40,000 real-time flights daily at major hubs world-wide. See live air traffic and join a living global flight network.

Join a Global Aviation Community!
RFS is more than just a flight game; it’s a living community.

• Fly with hundreds of aviators in real-time multiplayer modes.
• Chat with fellow pilots in the cockpit or global frequency.
• Join a Virtual Airline (VA) and compete in the leaderboards.

ATC Mode: Take Control of the Skies!
Become an Air Traffic Controller! 

• Manage live air traffic in our dedicated ATC game mode.
• Issue instructions, guide planes to the runway, and ensure safe navigation.
• Experience high-fidelity multi-voice ATC communications.

Create and Share Your Passion!

• Customize Your Plane: Design custom airplane liveries and share them globally.
• Design Your Airport: Build your own HD airport and watch the community take off.
• Plane Spotter Mode: Capture 3D screenshots and share with airplane game fans.
• Dynamic Environment: Experience stunning sunrise and sunsets in highest fidelity.

Technical Sim Features:

• Multi-panel instruments for advanced avionics.
• Realistic 3D spatial audio and real-time weather.
• Complex failure simulation including engines and gear.
• Weight and balance for realistic flight physics.

An Internet connection is required for real-time simulation and multiplayer.
Some features and airplanes require a subscription.

Get Ready to Soar!
Buckle up, push the throttle, and become a Real Pilot in RFS!

Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: Driving Zone: Germany Pro
summary: Driving simulator with German cars. Racing car games without ads and limits.
description:
Driving Zone: Germany Pro – the premium version of the popular car game and street racing simulator, without ads or limitations. Experience the thrill of driving legendary German cars with ultra-realistic physics and graphics.

- 20,000 bonus coins.
- Completely ad-free. Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with no distractions.
- Free driving mode. Your car will never break down, allowing you to enjoy endless driving fun.
- Unified cloud save and progress synchronization with the free version of the game.

Explore a variety of game modes:
- Career Mode: Complete exciting missions like parking challenges, time-based races, overtaking in traffic, and long-distance driving.
- Driving School: Master essential driving skills in a test environment, navigating cones and learning advanced techniques.
- Street Racing: Compete on highways, city streets, or icy winter tracks with dynamic weather changes.

- Drag Racing: Compete in high-speed, straight-line races on a 402-meter drag track.

- Test Track: Learn driving mechanics in a controlled environment.

- Drag Strip: Push your car’s speed to the limit in drag races.

- High-quality 3D graphics and ultra realistic car physics.
- Prototypes of legendary german cars with customization and tuning options.

name: Earn to Die
summary: Can you survive the zombie apocalypse? Choose your car and smash those zombies!
description:
Drive your way through a zombie apocalypse!

Are you ready to drive for your life? The hit online game series that has enjoyed OVER 200 MILLION PLAYS has been revamped and re-engineered for your mobile and tablet, bigger and better than ever before!

You're stranded in a desert surrounded by zombies. With only a run-down car and a small amount of cash at your disposal, your mission soon becomes clear – to drive through hordes of zombies in order to escape... alive!


THE BEST OF THE ACTION, DRIVING AND UPGRADE GENRES
Earn to Die sees you not only driving your way through hordes of zombies, but allows you to earn cash to upgrade, unlock and customise new vehicles. Is your vehicle not strong enough? Why not add a gun, or boosters, or even a spiked frame?



Key Features
● A brand new and extended STORY MODE which sees you driving cross-country during a zombie apocalypse
● 8 VEHICLES at your disposal, including a race-car, a truck and even a school bus!
● UPGRADES GALORE! Just unlocking a vehicle isn't enough, customise each vehicle with a range of upgrades
● Zombiesssssssssssss... Plenty of zombies... Be sure to introduce them to your car's front bumper
● A realistic ragdoll physics engine that allows you to crash into zombies and send them flying!
● Awesome animated sequences
● Race for the best time in Championship Mode
● Survived the zombie apocalypse? Smash through pumpkins in Halloween Mode



With over 200 Million Plays to the original online version, be one of the first to download the extended, BIGGER and BETTER version for your Android device.

name: Mini Metro
summary: Design a subway map for a growing city.
description:
Mini Metro, the sublime subway simulator, now on Android. No ads or in-app purchases.

• 2016 BAFTA nominee
• 2016 IGF award winner
• 2016 IGN Mobile Game of the Year finalist
• 2016 Gamespot's Best Mobile Game selection

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

• Random city growth means each game is unique.
• Over two dozen of real-world cities to test your planning skills.
• A variety of upgrades so you can tailor your network.
• Normal mode for quick scored games, Endless to relax, or Extreme for the ultimate challenge.
• Build your metro exactly how you want to with the all-new Creative mode.
• Compete against the world every day in the Daily Challenge.
• Colorblind and night modes.
• Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace.

Please note that Mini Metro is incompatible with some Bluetooth headphones. If you do not hear audio over Bluetooth, please try disconnecting your headphones and restarting the game.

name: The Sun Origin Post Apocalypse
summary: Post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG.
description:
Autumn sale: Save 75% on The Sun: Origin!

The Sun: Origin is a post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG that will challenge you to survive in a harsh and unforgiving world. Explore the wastelands, build your character, and fight for your life against mutants, bandits, and other survivors.

Key Features:

* Explore a vast and dangerous world: The wastelands are full of resources and dangers. Explore every corner of the map to find valuable loot, but be prepared to fight for it.
* Build your character: Choose from a variety of classes and customize your character's skills and abilities. Level up your character and become stronger as you progress through the game.
* Fight for your survival: The wastelands are full of enemies, both human and mutant. Fight for your life against bandits, raiders, and even other survivors.
* Craft your gear: Use the resources you find in the wastelands to craft weapons, armor, and other equipment. Build the best gear you can to survive in this harsh world.

The Sun: Origin is a challenging game, but it is also a rewarding one. If you are up for the challenge, then this game is for you.

Download The Sun: Origin today and experience the post-apocalyptic wasteland for yourself!

name: Shadow Knight: Ninja Fighting
summary: A Legendary Action RPG With Ninja Shadow Legends Fighting Style Offline Games!
description:
Hot Sale is here! Hurry up and get the most stunning items and unique skins for free to equip your unique hero and fight to become Shadow Legends.

name: Survival Island: Evolve Pro
summary: Survival has become even more difficult, dangerous and exciting!
description:
Many centuries have passed before the humanity has finally achieved its long awaited goal – we have conquered the Earth and enslaved the nature forces. But you know how they say, the bigger they are – the harder they fall. Eventually we did fall and it was hard. Environmental cataclysm exploded, covering every major city in toxic smog, the atmosphere became less and less livable with each passing day, the Earth’s light started to decay. The only way of delaying the inevitable turned out to be a special emulsion obtained out of the rarest metal Pridium. The Earth Protection Committee formed a special task force in order to discover new worlds rich in Pridium. You stepped up as a volunteer and departed for the unexplored territory but as it usually happens, something went wrong. You woke up on an island with no team, no water or food, no clothes and only with a dull head and a heap of questions. You must survive by all means and get back home. It won’t be easy so get going and good luck!

Game features:
* Explore the wilderness! 
* Build your house from the ground up!
* Utilize an extensive crafting system with tons of recipes
* Meet the island fauna! 
* Island survival sandbox simulator

name: Bike Mayhem Mountain Racing
summary: Rip down tons of mountains while busting tricks on your custom bike!
description:
Downhill mountain bike racing like never before. Race down beautiful trails, smashing over rocks and roots, boosting huge jumps, scoring insane trick combos, unlocking better bikes and gear for bragging rights as the King of the Mountain!

The best mobile bike game, Bike Mayhem Extreme Mountain Racing! 

Compete in timed races or freestyle trick events on 19 different mountains and over 100 trails inspired by real world locations.

Unlock over 80 items of gear to add style your rider and tune your bike for speed, agility, strength, and energy for each trail.

Experience realistic physics and plush bike suspension as your bike eats up the rough stuff and softens the landings of big jumps and drops. 
High speeds and big jumps means huge crashes where your rider will ragdoll tumble down the trail. Use your finger to pick up you rider throw him even further.

Share your races with your friends. Challenge them to beat your times! 

Brought to you by the makers of the epically popular Motocross racing game: Moto X Mayhem, which reached #1 Paid App worldwide and was a Top 5 Racing game for over a year! 

FEATURES: 

- 100+ Beautiful mountain trails for all styles of riding
- 80+ Gear items for your rider and MTB bike 
- Frame and wheel upgrades that impact game play
- Epic bike crashes, fun rag doll physics and active bike suspension
- Tricks, bunny hops and flips! 
- Addictive gameplay 
- Powerful online leaderboards

TIPS: 

- If you use check points, you will get a maximum of one star. Stay on your bike to achieve 3 stars! 
- Lean to add flips into your trick combo. 
- Wheelie into and out of a jump to add to your trick combo.
- Hold down the pump/hop button when entering a downhill section to get a boost in speed.
- Wheelies do not drain your energy
- The timer doesn't start until you start to pedal the bike or brake! 
- Use your finger to grab the rider and toss him around the map when you're on or off the bike. 
- Make sure you pick the right frame and wheel combination to get the best score for each trail.
-Use boosters to help you through a difficult trail or to get the top position on the leaderboard.

name: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redu
summary: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux - Post-Apocalyptic Action Shooter
description:
Survive deadly combat and stealth in the poisoned wasteland of Chernobyl Zone. Play as Serioga, lead your people to safety in the old subway tunnels, and fight for survival in this immersive post-apocalyptic world.

Long Description:

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is an epic, story-driven first person post-apocalyptic shooter from AGaming+. In 2014, an apocalypse destroyed most of humanity and turned the Earth's surface into a poisoned wasteland. It's now 2034, and as the surface of the Earth freezes, people must seek shelter in the old subway tunnels.

You play as Serioga, a survivor born just before the apocalypse, who must lead your people to safety and fight for survival against terrifying enemies. Explore the dangerous world, scavenge for resources, and engage in deadly combat and stealth.

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is one of the most immersive game worlds ever created, with stunning graphics and realistic sound effects. Can you survive and lead your people to safety? Play Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux now and find out.

name: Hitman: Absolution
summary: Plan. Adapt. Assassinate.
description:
CONTRACTS MODE
Hitman’s unlimited sandbox mode — take on player-designed contracts from other agents around the world, or create and share your own.

===

Branded a traitor and hunted by the Agency he once served, Agent 47 returns to Android in Hitman: Absolution.

Stalk your targets through elaborate environments that reward both quick thinking and patient planning. Strike silently from the shadows, or let your silverballers do the talking — whatever your approach, each of Absolution’s 20 missions is a contract killer’s happy hunting ground.

Expertly adapted for mobile play, Absolution’s sleek touchscreen controls offer 47’s hallmark precision, with gamepad and keyboard & mouse support included for the full AAA experience on the go.

SIGNATURE STYLE
Blend into the background, kill silently and disappear without trace, or go in all guns blazing! Absolution’s missions invite you to experiment, improvise and perfect your technique.

COMPLETE CONTROL
Customise touch controls until they fit you like a glove, or connect a gamepad or any Android-compatible keyboard & mouse.

MORE THAN A NUMBER
The story of Absolution puts Agent 47’s character under the spotlight, where both his loyalties and his conscience are put to the test.

KILLER INSTINCT
Use Instinct Mode to identify targets, predict enemy movement, and highlight points of interest.

CLEAR YOUR PATH
Use Point Shooting to stop time, mark multiple enemies, and eliminate them in a heartbeat.

MASTER THE CRAFT
Find new ways to take out your marks, complete Challenges, or take the ultimate test in Purist mode, with deadlier enemies and no help to guide you.

Hitman’s unlimited sandbox mode — take on player-designed contracts from other agents around the world, or create and share your own.

name: Wreckfest - Demolition Racing
summary: Break the rules and take full-contact racing to the limit with Wreckfest!
description:
🏁 Wreckfest is jam-packed with upgrade and customization options. Whether you are preparing for your next demolition derby with reinforced bumpers, roll cages, side protectors and much more, or setting your car up for a banger race with engine performance parts like air filters, camshafts, fuel systems, etc., Wreckfest is shaping up to be the best combative motorsport game out there. 💥

• Unique Racing Experience – Exhilarating no-rules racing action with defining, once-in-a-lifetime moments that can be achieved only with a true-to-life physics simulation. Witness insane neck-to-neck fighting on high-speed circuits, face total destruction madness on crazy courses with intersections and oncoming traffic, or go for demolition dominance in derby arenas.

• Awesome Cars – Our cars are old, banged up, patched together... They ooze style and character! From old American heavy-hitters to agile Europeans and fun Asians, you won’t find anything like this in other games.

Modify your car to make a robust tank or a fragile but lightning-fast rocket, or anything in between!

• Multiplayer – Wreck your friends in local multiplayer and take racing to the limit while chasing for demolition dominance!

• Career Mode – Battle for championships, earn experience, unlock new upgrades and cars, and become the all-time Wreckfest champion!

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
summary: Epic fantasy tower defense, return to Linirea and rewrite the kingdom's past
description:
Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis, the latest chapter in the legendary tower defense saga. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, command epic heroes, and stop a young Vez'nan before the kingdom falls, on a battlefield where every tower placement matters.

Build, upgrade, and outwit waves of goblins, orcs, and worse across the original Kingdom Rush lands. Offline. Pure tower defense.
History is broken. The Kingdom has fallen. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past.

A PREQUEL WITH STAKES
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and uncover the moment that turned a young mage into the saga's greatest villain.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them.  Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break. Classic tower defense, refined.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.
